Geometry status

This is a photograph-derived relief model, not a calibrated full-object photogrammetry scan. The visible surface is textured from the original photo; depth is inferred from shading and contrast. The back and thickness are neutral synthetic geometry because those surfaces are not fully measured in the supplied images.

Dimensions are normalized, not metric. Orthographic viewing removes added perspective in the 3D viewer, but cannot undo perspective or lens distortion already baked into the source photograph.

Export meshes

The GLB files open in common 3D viewers and retain the photo-textured relief shell. Depth and back-side geometry are approximate, as disclosed above.
